title: PLC Software Engineer (m/f/d) - Lübeck
description:
**🧭 .NET / Software Development Engineer – Lübeck (Industrial Automation)** 




  





**📍Lübeck \| 💶 €75,000 \- €100,000 \+ Bonus \| 🌍 Remote Working** 




  





 An innovative engineering company is looking for an experienced .NET / Software Development Engineer to join their growing development team. The company develops intelligent industrial systems used across commercial and industrial environments worldwide.
 



  





 The Software Development Engineer will work with technologies including:
 



  





*VB.NET, C\#, .NET, PLC Programming, Embedded Software, C/C\+\+, Visual Studio, Industrial Automation, Control Systems, Windows Applications, Software Testing, Version Control, Backend Development, Embedded Systems, and Technical Software Solutions.* 




  





**About the Role** 




 As a Software Development Engineer, you will develop and enhance embedded and industrial software systems, including control logic, engineering tools, and technical applications. You will collaborate closely with hardware, production, and international engineering teams to build scalable and reliable solutions.
 



  





 ➕
 **Nice to Have** 



* Experience with industrial automation or embedded software
* Knowledge of PLC programming and control systems
* Experience with VB.NET, C/C\+\+, or Structured Text (IEC 61131\-3\)
* Strong problem\-solving and communication skills



  





 💪
 **Benefits** 



* Flexible and hybrid working options
* competitive salary and long\-term stability
* Structured onboarding and training
* Modern engineering environment with international projects



  





*✉️ Due to the high number of applications, we may not be able to respond to everyone, but we truly appreciate the time and effort taken to apply and will be in touch with shortlisted candidates.*
